title: File control: READ UPDATE / REWRITE / UNLOCK on a KSDS; REWRITE after UNLOCK is INVREQ RESP2 30, UNLOCK with nothing held is NORMAL; non-UPDATE READ INTO with LENGTH below the record length is LENGERR

scenarios.summary: READ UPDATE of K002, REWRITE of it (NORMAL), and a READ that sees the new record
READ UPDATE of K002, UNLOCK, then REWRITE: INVREQ RESP2 30, and the record is unchanged
UNLOCK with no READ UPDATE outstanding is NORMAL; REWRITE with no READ UPDATE is INVREQ RESP2 30
READ INTO of K002 with LENGTH 8 on a 16-byte record: LENGERR; a READ with LENGTH 16 then returns the record
